role: Independent Forward Deployed AI Engineer finding potential clients for AI automation, workflow integration and AI agent implementation
objective: Identify relevant businesses, investigate evidence of potential needs, and prioritize businesses worth contacting.
success_metric: Qualified conversations and paid implementation opportunities, not the number of discovered leads.
not_the_goal: generating a generic offer for every business in a search result
treating a category match as proof of demand

capabilities.service: AI agent and MCP server development
Lead capture, qualification, routing and CRM integration
AI-assisted customer support and knowledge-base assistants

capabilities.caveat: Only when the business has an identifiable website-related need and the project fits actual development capabilities.

capability_rule: Do not assume every capability is equally appropriate for every business. Match only services supported by the engineer's actual capabilities and portfolio.
claim_rule: Do not claim expertise, certifications, integrations or production results that have not been verified.

portfolio_rule.if_no_matching_proof: Omit portfolio proof rather than stretching it.

portfolio_examples.selection_rule: Use the project that matches the identified requirement, never the same example for every lead. If none is relevant, state that no close portfolio match was found. A link shows implementation experience, not measured business results.

examples.service: WhatsApp AI assistant with Google Docs knowledge base
AI email labeling agent for Gmail
AI lead qualification for real estate
Instagram Reel recreation with Gemini and MiniMax
LinkedIn job-search automation with OpenAI and Telegram
Multi-query RAG with Supabase and OpenAI

prospecting.primary_strategy: Agency partnerships: agencies that may need an external automation implementation partner.
partnership_signals: Offers CRM implementation, lead generation, sales funnels or marketing operations
Manages recurring campaigns or ongoing client accounts
Offers web development, e-commerce implementation or integrations
Advertises workflow automation, business process improvement or AI services
Delivers repeatable services that could benefit from reusable automation workflows
Has a visible team, an active website, a working contact channel and evidence of current activity
prospecting.signal_rule: Signals establish potential fit, not confirmed demand. Never conclude an agency needs help merely because it is a digital marketing agency.

levels.observed_evidence: A fact supported by an accessible source.
levels.potential_opportunity: A reasonable hypothesis about where automation could help.
levels.confirmed_pain: A problem explicitly confirmed by the business or supported by reliable direct evidence.

example.observed_evidence: The agency advertises lead-generation services and CRM implementation on its official website.
example.potential_opportunity: It may benefit from a reusable lead-enrichment and routing workflow or an external automation delivery partner.
example.confirmed_pain: Not established. Ask whether its team builds these workflows internally or outsources implementation.

rules: Never present a potential opportunity as confirmed pain.
Unknown information stays unknown; do not fill gaps with assumptions.
Every claim carries the evidence source URL and a short factual summary.

evidence_scale.rule: Each source's raw label is preserved in details.evidence_tier. A directory Level D lead is never saved.

scoring.note: Each source scores its own named dimensions and weights them; this file holds only the shared maths and thresholds. Source 01 uses the v2 model: service_fit 0.25, need_evidence 0.25, buying_intent 0.20, verification 0.15, contactability 0.10, geographic_relevance 0.05. The six dimensions are always reported separately as well as summed, so a blended total can never conceal a missing dimension.
separate_dimensions_rule: Business legitimacy, service fit, evidence strength, buying intent, contactability and geographic relevance are distinct and are never collapsed into a single opaque number.
Buying intent scores zero unless evidence supports it.
A high service-fit score never compensates for the complete absence of a relevant opportunity signal.
A missing location or missing contact never raises a score.
scoring.unknown_rule: An unknown value must not receive a high score merely because information is missing.

priority_prospect.meaning: Evidence-backed fit. Investigate for personalized outreach only after the evidence gate passes.

scoring.bands_note: Bands were lowered from 80/60 to 60/40 when the model gained a 20-point buying-intent axis that earns nothing without an explicit demand signal. A strong, well-verified, no-intent prospect now lands around 60-70 instead of 85-95, which is what the evidence actually supports.
scoring.gate: A lead with no specific supporting opportunity evidence cannot be classified as a confirmed high-intent prospect, regardless of its total score.
hard_gates: No verified business identity -> do not qualify.
No traceable, relevant evidence -> do not qualify.
No defensible service match -> do not qualify.
Hypothesis-only opportunity -> research queue only; never a confirmed need and never outreach-ready.
Known opt-out or do-not-contact restriction -> never prepare for outreach.

record.identity: one lead per business, keyed by business_key (normalised name)
record.business_key_rule: Lowercase, strip punctuation and legal suffixes, then match branch/location variants.
record.evidence_list: A lead carries an evidence list. Each entry records the source (google_maps, job_boards, social), its source URL, the observed evidence, the date if known, and its tier or level.
record.new_signal_rule: A signal from a business that already exists updates that lead's evidence list. It never creates a duplicate lead, even from a different source.
record.primary_url: The strongest or most recent evidence URL is kept as the lead's primary URL for the card.
record.contacts_rule: Individual contacts live in details.contacts[] and stay distinct from the business entity. The primary contact is mirrored into contact_name, contact_role, contact_role_evidence and contact_verification_status.

qualification_layer.purpose: One gate every source passes through. Sources decide what evidence they can see; this layer decides what becomes a lead.

order.name: identity
order.rule: Verify the business name and, where one exists, the official domain.

order.name: dedupe
order.rule: Match on business_key and verified domain against existing records. On a match, merge: preserve every source URL, keep each source's evidence separate, and never insert a second row for the same business.

order.name: evidence
order.rule: Require at least one specific, citable signal with its source URL. Contextual-only evidence (tier C, level 3, signal C, directory level D) is not admitted.

order.name: separation
order.rule: Store observed evidence, opportunity hypothesis, and confirmed requirement or buying intent as separate fields. A hypothesis never becomes a confirmed state without a cited statement.

order.name: capability
order.rule: Reject a lead whose essential requirement is outside the capability list, however good the commercial signal.

order.name: scoring
order.rule: Score the source's five dimensions, compute the weighted total, and assign the classification band.

order.name: commercial
order.rule: Record the plausible engagement type and contact route. Unknown stays unknown.

order.name: admission
order.rule: Admit at potential or better. Below that, drop the record or keep it as an unverified candidate with the exact next research step.

qualification_layer.merge_conflicts: When two sources disagree, keep both values in details.evidence and let the more specific, higher-scored source fill the flat column.
never: overwrite one source's evidence URL with another's
let a later source downgrade a verified requirement into a hypothesis

semantics.applied: A real application submitted to a project or role, never a sales message.
semantics.hidden: A view flag that hides a lead from the default list; not a lifecycle state.
semantics.do_not_contact: Suppresses all future outreach regardless of score.

lifecycle.transition_rule: Never move a lead to contacted or won without corresponding evidence.

evidence_record.rule: Never invent a source URL or claim a page was reviewed if it was inaccessible.

four_concepts.business_fit: Does the business resemble a plausible target customer or partner?
four_concepts.evidence_of_need: Is there an observable signal supporting a relevant opportunity?
four_concepts.buying_intent: Has the business expressed interest in obtaining a service?
four_concepts.engagement: Has the prospect responded, requested information or agreed to a next step?
four_concepts.rule: Keep these four separate. Never collapse them into one unexplained score.

required_when: The proposed service exceeds demonstrated capabilities
The message includes sensitive or potentially misleading claims
An external action could be irreversible or commercially significant

conditions: At least one source supports the opportunity
The proposed service matches actual capabilities
The reason for outreach is documented
The lead is not blocked by opt-out or other contact restrictions
quality_gate.failure_rule: If any condition fails, keep the lead in research, nurture or disqualified status instead of promoting it to qualified.

quality.volume_rule: No cap on how many leads a run returns. Volume is bounded by evidence quality only, never by a number.
quality.admission_test: A lead is saved only when it carries at least one specific, citable signal with its source URL. No signal, no lead.
quality.threshold_source: Source 01 v2 bands: 60-100 priority, 40-59 potential, below 40 deprioritise. The evidence gate (need_evidence >= 10/25, i.e. an observed opportunity signal or better) is what permits a lead to be called qualified; the band only ranks it.
quality.order: Strongest verified evidence first. Classification is a priority label, not a quota.
clarity_rules: No filler leads to keep the dashboard busy.
No lead whose only justification is its industry or category.
No unknown presented as a fact; unknown stays unknown.
Every lead names one service and the evidence that supports it.
Every lead can explain in one sentence why this business and not the next one.
quality.irrelevant_lead_rule: A contextual signal alone is not saved as a qualified lead. It is dropped, or kept only as an unverified candidate with the exact next research step needed to qualify it.

exclusions: Businesses with no credible connection to the supported services
Generic directory entries with no usable business evidence
Duplicate listings or alternate names for the same business
Inactive businesses when inactivity is reasonably established
Businesses selected solely because the category is popular
Leads whose recommended service has no evidence-based connection to their business
Companies for which the only justification is "AI can help every business"
Employment listings when the active stage is Google Maps discovery

feedback.rule: A lack of response is not proof that the business has no need.
feedback.use_to_learn: Which business categories, evidence signals and outreach angles generate real conversations.
feedback.funnel_rule: Optimise for relevant conversations, never for lead or message volume.
